scope: Independent presentation review of the complete learner volume; no key content or fresh task-solving audit.
reviewer_roles: The reviewer did not author the book assembly, new front matter, index typesetting, or raster verifier. Earlier work included Fulk appendix evidence/review, the late-unit semantic index proposal, and independent early-index semantic review. This receipt concerns rendered presentation and preservation, not a new independent semantic review of the entire index.

method.retained_header_body_comparison: System.Drawing without color management decodes every raster to top-down RGB8; exact channel-byte equality above the footer, with SHA-256 receipts and mismatch pixel bounds. PNG-filter prefix hashes are an independent sufficient equality check, not the final comparison criterion.

footer_exclusion.guard_expectation: Every RGB channel is 255 in the full-width blank gap around the cutoff.

method.whole_page_inspection: All 967 pages actually observed in 61 labelled contact sheets at original sheet resolution. Page images within sheets are reduced structural overviews; inspected sequence, margins, running heads, tables, continuations, clipping, collision, transitions and unexpected blank content.
method.footer_inspection: All 967 footer strips actually observed at native pixel resolution in 41 labelled sheets. Each printed numeral was checked against its labelled physical page/PDF folio, including the unprinted title folio and eight blank versos.
method.new_page_inspection: All 12 front-matter pages, 17 index pages and eight inserted blank versos actually opened individually at native page resolution using the 37 verified full-size proof copies. New text was checked for presentation, glyphs, wrapping and breaks.
method.additional_native_inspection: All 22 component opening pages and seven further representative glyph/table/detail pages actually opened as raw native page rasters before proof generation; their final PDF identity and pixel hashes were retained and revalidated.
method.preservation_basis: All 930 retained learner pages have exact decoded RGB header/body equality with the accepted standalone source pages through row 1327 inclusive. The full-width 224-226 mm guard band is white. Footer strips contain no omitted body material.
method.limits: Contact sheets do not establish a fresh word-by-word reading of all 967 pages. Retained linguistic content and glyph shapes inherit prior detailed acceptance via exact raster preservation. Only the 37 new/blank pages and 29 representative retained pages received individual native full-page inspection here. PDF click navigation and semantic index accuracy have separate reviews; this receipt does not claim to repeat them.

observations: No missing or clipped table, column collision, footer intrusion, unexpected blank page, or damaged visible special character was found.
Title and About page clearly identify the learner volume, separate answer key, local section numbering, source locators and bounded index scope.
Contents entries and page-number columns are complete and aligned; BLP-01 records the single nonblocking unit-heading break.
All 17 index pages have readable headwords, subentries, recognition/supplied qualifications, cross-references and page locators; long entries wrap inside their columns.

Native detail checks included pronunciation vowels and IPA, four adjective panels, breaking, palatal-diphthongization quantities, gemination/weight, and the dense Old English glossary. Macrons, ash, thorn, eth, hooked vowels, arrows and reconstruction marks remain intact.
All eight inserted blank versos are completely empty, without a printed folio or stray header/body ink.
